english.title: Contravene term, condition or restriction of sex establishment licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[holder]_
(B)_[servant or agent of the holder]_

of a licence under Schedule 3 to the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1982 for a sex establishment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE ESTABLISHMENT..), without reasonable excuse, knowingly

(C)_[contravened]_

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 20(1)(c) and 22(1) of Schedule 3 to the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1982.
english.pointstoprove:
